description: This file manages DNS records in Cloudflare, including adding and deleting CNAME records, with error handling and environment variable assertions.

methods.name: addDnsRecord
methods.description: Creates a DNS CNAME record in Cloudflare for a given domain, with error handling for existing records.

methods.name: deleteDnsRecord
methods.description: Deletes a DNS CNAME record in Cloudflare for a given domain, with error handling for record existence.

methods.name: api
methods.description: Performs an API request to Cloudflare with schema validation and error handling.

methods.name: assertCloudflareEnvVars
methods.description: Ensures required environment variables for Cloudflare API are set.

methods.name: isRecordAlreadyExistError
methods.description: Checks if errors correspond to record already existing error codes.

methods.name: isRecordNotExistingError
methods.description: Checks if errors correspond to record not existing error code.
